name: PR detail Files changed tab renders Smart Diff groups, collapse, and the order toggle
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm Smart Diff grouping (Rule 1): a role group header ('Docs') renders, collapsing it shows the 'N files' summary, and switching to Original order still shows the seeded file (src/config.ts). Read-only seeded data (no model call, no chat) — the seed spans core/wiring/docs/boilerplate roles so more than one group exists (see server/docs/insights.md). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md). Flow 05 stays the flat-list regression guard; this flow is Smart Diff's own coverage. NOTE: `wait --text` reads `document.body.innerText`, which reflects the header's `text-transform: uppercase` CSS — so that step matches 'DOCS', not the label's actual DOM text 'Docs'. The collapse click needs `--exact` (Next.js inlines the full next-intl messages blob, which contains the substring 'Docs', into a `<script>` tag that a non-exact `find text` can resolve to instead of the real header span) AND an explicit scroll first: the app scrolls inside `<main>`, not `window`, and the Docs group sits below the fold at the default viewport height, so the click silently lands nowhere without it (see e2e/docs/insights.md).
